title: Migration Strategies & The 6 Rs — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates migration rollback scenario: undetected application defect forces emergency reversal of cutover without data loss.
routing_rationale: Reverse replication pipelines established during cutover guarantee a safe fallback path if critical production bugs appear in the cloud environment.

nodes.label: Cloud Run App (Defective v2)
nodes.detail: New cloud microservice triggers memory leak under production concurrency.

nodes.label: Cloud SQL Primary
nodes.detail: Holds 45 minutes of new orders generated post-cutover.

nodes.label: Reverse CDC Replication Pipeline
nodes.detail: Streams new orders from Cloud SQL back to on-premise MySQL database.

nodes.label: On-Prem MySQL Primary
nodes.detail: Ready to resume live traffic without losing the 45 minutes of new orders.

steps.title: Reverse Synchronization Active
steps.action: Reverse replication channel continuously syncs new cloud transactions back to on-prem.
steps.why_traversal: Establishes a zero-data-loss safety net during the vulnerable post-cutover window.

steps.title: Controlled Emergency Rollback
steps.action: Cloud traffic halted; DNS reverted to on-prem; on-prem app resumes with complete data.
steps.why_traversal: Restores production reliability in minutes without data corruption or loss.

scenarios.label: Missing Reverse Replication Trap
scenarios.root_cause: Team omitted reverse CDC pipeline to save setup time.
scenarios.diverted_path: Rollback requires discarding 45 minutes of customer transactions or manual SQL patching.
scenarios.blast_radius: Severe business disruption and manual reconciliation.
scenarios.recovery: Mandate reverse replication pipelines as an architectural prerequisite for cutover approval.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
